caption: Step 1 of the window Create tracking number in CallRail: the question Where will you display this tracking number? with two cards, On my website (Track calls from your website and get details on website sessions, landing page, and web referrals.) and Somewhere else (Search ads, social media ads, directory sites, email signatures, print ads, and more.). The interface is in English. No personal data is shown.

Step 3, Number setup, of the same window: Choose your number's location with the switch Type: Local / Toll-free, the area code 212 in a red field with the message No numbers available for that area code., and the field Number name with Google Ads Assets. The button Number routing is grey. No price, card field or phone verification is shown.

The same step after the area code 415 was typed: Your new tracking number! We've auto-generated a number based on your business location., a card named Google Ads Assets with the suggested phone number (covered by a box), the buttons Copy and Regenerate, the switch Local / Toll-free, the area code 415 with the line Area code local to California, and the button Number routing. No price, card field or phone verification is shown, and the number was not chosen.

Step 4, Number routing, where the test stopped: Call routing, Where do you want to route these calls? with Forward to phone number selected and an empty field Search or enter a number, the option Use Call flow, Activate call recording ticked with the message This call may be recorded and shared with third-party providers., Activate whisper message unticked, and the grey button Activate tracking number. Nothing was entered or activated.
